title: Grateful Dead Live at Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U. on 1969-05-11
venue: Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U.

ai_review.summary: Muddy, cut‑filled soundboard of a historic San Diego show with a killer Dead/Santana jam and an electrifying Other One, but overall uneven performance.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a historically important May 1969 San Diego concert that featured Santana, Canned Heat and the Grateful Dead. While the Dead’s set includes a jaw‑dropping Other One sequence and a fiery Dead/Santana jam, the soundboard source is plagued by mud, compression and frequent cuts, making it hard to enjoy fully.

ai_rating.rationale: Many reviewers praise specific moments (Other One, Dead/Santana jam) but repeatedly criticize the poor, muddy and cut‑ridden recording; the combined show and audio quality yields an average‑plus rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy overall tone, noticeable compression, frequent dropouts/cuts, and occasional blown‑out levels; generally less clear than the comparable 5/29/69 recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festival‑style day with multiple opening acts; Dead's set was energetic but some listeners felt it lacked the usual fire, and the warm weather/long day may have affected energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "totally fired up" during the Other One and dead‑stop jam; a cut cuts out his signature circular loopy build‑up.
